changes.title: A customer is never charged twice for one booking
changes.why: A repeated payment takes money for a booking that was already confirmed.

criteria.text: Paying with a reference that was already used does not confirm a second booking
A booking is confirmed once its payment is verified

changes.title: Customers are asked for consent before their details are saved
changes.forWhom: Customers who give a name and phone number
changes.why: Saving personal details without asking can lead to a complaint to the regulator.

criteria.text: A customer sees the privacy notice and agrees before the booking is saved
